answer.reason: Genesis 14 and Hebrews 7 state what Melchizedek did: he met Abram with bread and wine, blessed him, and received tithes.

clauses.english: brought out bread and wine and blessed Abram, who gave him tithes of all
clauses.quote: he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God

doubts: The Psalm 110 and Hebrews verses speak of Christ as a priest after his order, so they are not deeds of Melchizedek and were left out.
The clause joins the blessing and the tithes, which are two things in one scene; they were kept as one meeting with Abram.
